raw:
Agent Name: Validation_Expert
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The validator asserted that the NIH page confirmed an “Actual Enrollment” of 100 and that all criteria matched, but provided no real verification and likely conflated “Estimated” with “Actual” enrollment and/or misapplied the Jan–May 2018 constraint. This false validation allowed an unverified (and thus wrong) enrollment figure to be accepted as the final answer.
